description: Validation benchmark for Adaptive Multi-Tier RAG across real-world personal study materials (E:\me\Documents\学习资料)

scenarios.name: cross_document_radar_search
scenarios.title: 跨文档雷达宏观定位 (Cross-Document Macro Radar Search)
scenarios.material_type: Multi-book library (50+ mixed technical books, manuals, and papers)
scenarios.query: 我这几十本书和资料里，哪几本详细讲了 epoll 的水平触发 (LT) 与边缘触发 (ET) 的区别？
scenarios.ground_truth_assertion: Must return top candidate books and chapters in a single turn without sequentially browsing documents one-by-one.

scenarios.name: fast_syntax_param_lookup
scenarios.title: 语法参数与确切事实闪电快查 (Fast Syntax & Parameter Lookup)
scenarios.material_type: Dense technical manual / Language specification (e.g., Go/Kubernetes spec)
scenarios.query: Go 语言标准库中 sync.Pool 私有对象回收发生在 GC 的哪一个具体阶段？
scenarios.ground_truth_assertion: Must pinpoint the exact sentence/paragraph and expand to its natural subsection in under 1 second without reading table of contents.

scenarios.name: deep_single_book_study
scenarios.title: 单本大作连续深度沉浸研读 (Deep Single-Book Continuous Study Session)
scenarios.material_type: Thick textbook / 800-page monograph (e.g., 分布式系统原理与工程实践)

session_turns.query: 简要概述本书第三章复制状态机模型的核心假设。
为什么 Raft 协议不允许非 Leader 节点直接向状态机提交日志？请结合第四章安全原则详细说明。
对比第三章 Paxos 与第四章 Raft 在选举阶段日志冲突时的决断差异，指出优劣。

scenarios.ground_truth_assertion: Turn >= 2 must hit KV cache with sub-second response, utilizing full-document attention without multi-turn tree backtracking.

scenarios.name: slides_flat_notes_without_toc
scenarios.title: 无目录 PPT 课件与散篇笔记解析 (Unstructured Slides & Notes Without TOC)
scenarios.material_type: PDF exported from Keynote/PowerPoint or flat Markdown notes (0 TOC nodes)
scenarios.query: 第 28 页的微服务熔断降级策略包含哪三个核心阈值指标？
scenarios.ground_truth_assertion: Must gracefully handle empty TOC structures without hanging or falling back to sequential blind page traversal.

scenarios.name: multimodal_diagram_formula
scenarios.title: 多模态系统架构图与公式原页直读 (Multimodal Architecture Diagram & Math Page)
scenarios.material_type: Paper with complex vector architecture diagrams and formulas (Figure 4 on page 17)
scenarios.query: 请结合第 17 页的系统交互时序图，解释协调器向参与者发送 Prepare 消息失败后的超时回滚路径。
scenarios.ground_truth_assertion: Must detect high visual complexity and pass the rendered PDF page image directly to VLM rather than relying on stripped plain text.
